reels.title: QUITTING NICOTINE
reels.caption:
Quitting nicotine? 3 signs the loop is breaking. Most people miss #3 💨

1️⃣ Late at night, you don't reach for a hit.
2️⃣ The craving spikes. 10 minutes later, it's gone.
3️⃣ You slip once, and you don't start over. One slip is −5, not zero.

Which sign are you on? 👇
Send this to someone who's quitting.
